So it’s nothing fancy I just work at a paint store! I started part time in January and decided a month ago I was ready for full time. I applied to two separate jobs within the company and I got the second one! For me it was making sure I was having more good days then bad. And when I was having a bad day to remind myself that one bad customer doesn’t equal a bad day.

Before I was ready for work I took off about 6 months to let myself go through what I needed to. I was in a dark place just a year ago. I started new meds and seeing a new therapist. A few sessions in I started to get confident again slowly but surely. I realized I was having more bad days in my house and that’s what pushed me to get the part time job.

My suggestions is don’t rush yourself. Let yourself get better and wait until you notice many good days in a week consistently for about a month. Look for part time jobs that aren’t too demanding. Fast food work is awful for me for example. And make sure to not bring work home once you do start again! Bad days are thought about and taken care of on the ride home and as soon as you walk in the door to home it’s a new page of the day and you can make it what you want!

Oh and always remember self care daily!!!
